_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id}, udlala {num_rounds} imizuliswano ye-Iterated Ultimatum Game. Unama-${pool} ukuze uhlukanise lo mjuliswano phakathi kwakho noMdlali {other_id}. Ophakamisa: - Yenza isipho: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool) - Uma samukelwa → Uthola $(pool - X), omunye umdlali uthola $X - Uma senqatshelwe → Bobabili bathola $0 - Isibonelo: [Offer: $3] noma 'Ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kulungile. [Offer: $5]' Ophendulayo: - Nquma ngesipho noma nge [Accept] noma [Reject] - Isibonelo: 'Lokho kubonakala kunengqondo. [Accept]' 'Akulungile kakhulu. [Reject]'

round.begins: --- Umjikelezo {round_number} uyaqala! --- Umdlali {proposer_id} uyena owenza isiphakamiso, Umdlali {responder_id} uyena ophendulayo.
round.accepted: Umdlali {responder_id} wamukelwa! Umjikelezo {round_number} uzuza: Umdlali {proposer_id} + ${proposer_gain}, Umdlali {responder_id} + ${responder_gain}. Amanani amasha: Umdlali 0: ${total_0}, Umdlali 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Umdlali {responder_id} wenqaba ukunikezwa! Umjikelezo {round_number} uzuza: Bobabili abadlali + $ 0. Amanani ahlala: Umdlali 0: ${total_0}, Umdlali 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Umfakisicelo kufanele enze isicelo sokukhishwa kwesicelo esebenzisa ifomethi [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Inani lomnikelo kufanele libe yinombolo ephelele evumelekile.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umnikelo kufanele ube phakathi kuka-$0 no-${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Akukho sipho samanje okufanele sisabele kuso.

outcome.win: Umdlali {winner} unqobe ngo- ${winner_total} isiyonke vs Umdlali {loser} ngo- ${loser_total}.
